parameters.content:
## 3 · POST → immediate 200 → HMAC → messages only
Raw body is required for X-Hub-Signature-256. Status callbacks produce no jobs. All entries/messages are processed in timestamp order, one at a time. Invalid signatures are discarded after acknowledgment and logged as errors.

parameters.content:
## 4 · Serial state engine — Google Sheets OAuth2
Required: ONE n8n process, N8N_CONCURRENCY_PRODUCTION_LIMIT=1. No overlapping manual executions or other sheet writers.
Read Orders/Sessions/Messages → authorize customer phone → plan changes → optional Gemini → atomic Sheets batchUpdate.
Model lives ONLY in the configuration node. Sheet IDs are resolved from tab metadata. No paid nodes or LLM framework.

parameters.content:
## 6 · Send only inside customer service window
Reply is committed before sending. Duplicate message ID + sent → skip; prepared/failed → reuse persisted reply without repeating state changes.
WhatsApp has no exactly-once guarantee: a crash after a successful send but before marking sent can duplicate the reply. Never automatically retry sending HTTP requests. Errors store codes only, without tokens or payloads.
